# Diatreme

> Diatreme is a release/deployment orchestrator: a GitHub Marketplace composite action for semantic-release across TBD and BBD workflows, plus the Cloudflare Worker GitHub App backend that supports it (OIDC token broker + App/bot-attributed commit/tag signer). Install the action with `uses: magmamoose/diatreme@v1`.

This repository has two surfaces: the **composite action** (`action.yml` + `scripts/`) published to the GitHub Marketplace, and the **Cloudflare Worker** (`worker/`) deployed to `api.diatreme.magmamoose.com`. They communicate over HTTP and neither imports the other. Most users only need the action.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Marketplace user guide — quickstart, required permissions, examples, inputs, outputs, and language-package publishing.
- [Worker reference](worker/README.md): Worker endpoints (`/token` broker, `/sign` signer, `/releases`), configuration, and deploy.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): contributor/agent guide — repository boundary, required files, local validation, editing rules.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): notable changes (Keep a Changelog + Semantic Versioning).

## Action

- Install: `uses: magmamoose/diatreme@v1` (floating major tag). The default `auth-mode: public-app` needs `id-token: write` and the hosted [Diatreme GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/diatreme).
- Modes: `ci` (PR image build, branch-naming gate), `release` (versioning, GitHub Release, image promotion, promotion PRs), `enable-auto-merge`.
- Versioning tools: `semantic-release-python`, `semantic-release-npm`, `gitversion`, `release-please`.
- Package publishing: `nuget`, `npm`, `maven`, `gradle`, `rubygems`, `container`, `pip` — to GitHub Packages or public registries, on github.com and GitHub Enterprise.

## Worker

- Role: the GitHub App backend for release flows — OIDC token broker and App/bot-attributed commit/tag signer. No Copilot/triage/PR-automation features.
- Source: [worker/src/index.ts](worker/src/index.ts) — `export default { fetch }`.
- Deploy: [.github/workflows/deploy-worker.yaml](.github/workflows/deploy-worker.yaml) via Cloudflare Wrangler.
- Hosted broker base URL: `https://api.diatreme.magmamoose.com`.

## Related

- [MagmaMoose/diatreme-pro](https://github.com/MagmaMoose/diatreme-pro): the private observability dashboard (FastAPI + React/Vite) for this worker.
